scope: Provisional ID agentic benchmarks only. This queue selects new authoring work; it does not change benchmark coverage states.

selection_policy.primary: At each selection, maximize the number of currently missing distinct ID task workflows the next coherent task is expected to complete.
selection_policy.deduplication: Use benchmark/task identity and explicit shared-task relations. Related protocol records receive no extra priority credit and still need separate protocol validation.
selection_policy.counting: A shared tool, component mapping, broad family label or uninspected identifier contributes no completed-task credit. Conditional candidate counts are upper bounds until all data and endpoint requirements pass.
constraints: Observed independent biological inputs; no benchmark fixtures or answers.
A coherent connected scientific workflow, one task per recipe by default, offline and at most 30 minutes.
Input-reading oracle and complete deterministic artifact checks; no teacher model API calls or LLM judge for generation or grading.
Preserve every OOD assignment; do not inspect OOD tasks for authoring.
tiebreakers: Likelihood of completing the target endpoints with accessible, scientifically appropriate data.
Less incremental authoring and validation effort.
New biological/workflow coverage when gains and feasibility are comparable.
selection_policy.secondary: Repository and format coverage support the chosen ID workflows; adding a repo alone earns no priority credit.
selection_policy.refresh: After every completed or rejected candidate, recompute its remaining target set from benchmark inventories, remove newly covered shared targets from later candidates, reassess blockers and choose again. Record evidence before promoting any benchmark mapping.
selection_policy.scope_limit: Ranks compare the currently assessed candidate set, not all possible workflows in all releases. Source-review backlog entries remain explicit and can change the ranking.

selection_reason: Question-level endpoint designs now cover the review scope of all 355 BixBench, CompBioBench and BiomniBench-DA records. These are proposals with unresolved inputs and method contracts; no new executable coverage. The approved model-free Harbor interface check passed all three expected cases, including login-terminal PATH. Select the next recipe after independent-input feasibility and cross-benchmark design overlap are assessed.

candidates.coverage_estimate: Conditional target count after inspecting required stages. This is neither measured coverage nor a probability-weighted prediction; blockers can reduce the count.
required_stages: Resolve observed single-copy ortholog groups across two biological clades and retain gene/taxon identity.
Align each group, infer or reuse provenance-pinned gene trees, and declare rooting, gaps, taxon eligibility and branch policies.
Compute PhyKIT treeness, RCV, informative sites, saturation, branch distances, evolutionary rates, tree length and root-to-tip dispersion.
Retain per-tip and per-pair measurements, then aggregate within genes before comparing gene distributions.
Join matched orthologs across clades; calculate differences, ratios, thresholds, quantiles and explicitly parameterized Mann-Whitney tests.
required_artifacts: complete aligned FASTA and Newick per eligible gene
per-site, per-tip and per-pair measurements as applicable
candidates.data_readiness: The existing COX1 example supplies one gene and is insufficient. Independent multi-locus observations and supported ortholog assignments must be frozen before authoring.
blockers: Find and check independent observed groups; do not reuse the benchmark fungal/animal fixtures or treat inference methods as biological replicates.
Inspect and execute the pinned PhyKIT functions, including rooting behavior, four-decimal outputs and undefined ratios.
Named-gene endpoints must retain a gene lookup on independently chosen orthologs; this covers their workflow pattern, not original biological answers.
Define finite coverage rules for missing taxa, zero denominators, ties and empty sets without inventing observations.
Demonstrate the complete connected task finishes within 30 minutes.
candidates.effort_tiebreak: High: new multi-locus source preparation and package-specific metric checks; reuses existing alignment/tree execution.
candidates.conditional_extra_reason: The endpoint requires naturally observed alignments exceeding 70% gaps. It adds no rank credit until such data are verified; no artificial gaps will be inserted.

source_assessments.limitation: Anonymous Dryad download remains blocked. The pinned author mirror has separately validated individual alignments and matching trees.
Multiple pruned groups share an original orthogroup. Twenty independent original loci remain unverified. Four taxon spellings are unresolved. No native phylogenetic metrics or task execution yet.

findings.finding: The implementation explicitly preserves a historical set(tip) bug, using characters from an identifier rather than a singleton taxon set. For ordinary multi-character taxon identifiers it includes the zero self-distance in the per-tip mean, unlike a mean over other taxa.
findings.decision: Keep all six targets conditional. The task must distinguish version-specific native output from the self-excluded scientific statistic and verify both before any coverage promotion.

findings.finding: This pinned implementation computes sample standard deviation of root-to-tip distances without dividing by their mean. Root choice and the exclusion of outgroups must therefore be explicit.

candidates.title: Audit observed single-cell counts through normalization, embedding and group structure
candidates.coverage_estimate: Conditional target count after inspecting required stages. This is neither measured coverage nor a probability-weighted prediction; blockers can reduce the count.
required_stages: Read native h5ad raw/count layers with stable cell and feature IDs.
Validate endogenous/mitochondrial features and count-based cell QC.
Normalize, assess depth effects, select variable genes and diagnose PCA preprocessing.
Compute the declared embedding and neighbor graph; retain marker-expression joins.
Compare community assignments and group-profile hierarchical structure under explicit representations.
required_artifacts: embedding/neighbor graph and cell-keyed marker panels
candidates.data_readiness: GSE81682 observed counts and QC are already frozen. Native h5ad preparation, mitochondrial annotation and endpoint suitability remain to be checked.

Validate numerical plotting data, eigenvector/subspace and partition semantics without a visual judge.
Keep the complete sparse computation within the task memory/time budget.
candidates.effort_tiebreak: Medium: reuse observed matrix and QC; add h5ad, normalization and representation checks.

execution_policy.coordination: The lead selects candidates, designs scientifically coherent workflows, evaluates source suitability, reviews oracle independence and approves coverage-state changes.
execution_policy.delegation: Use one bounded worker for factual source search, pinned installation, routine oracle execution or artifact validation. Start with gpt-6-sol; simpler mechanical work can use gpt-6-luna when scoped clearly.
worker_boundaries: Assign exact files or outputs, allowed actions, evidence requirements and a stopping point.
No task, coverage, source or validation claims are accepted without lead review.
Do not run heavy local work in both lead and worker simultaneously; honor shared-node load, memory and locking requirements.
Do not repeat failed installations or compute jobs without diagnosis and existing authorization.

solver_diagnostics.purpose: Inspect solver traces, complete artifact grades, instruction ambiguity, runtime and token use before further recipe implementation. Existing task bytes and graders are unchanged.
solver_diagnostics.result: Assembly reward 1; RNA population-interaction reward 0 for summary record shape. A separate read-only comparison matches all seven RNA artifact tables; original reward remains unchanged.

next_actions.work: Validate the updated login-shell native-tool PATH in a fresh Harbor terminal. Public summary shape and failure artifact reporting have focused local regression coverage; preserve original solver results.
Turn proposed workstream questions into exact endpoint assignments. Preserve study/assay differences and known aliases; freeze independent observed inputs before estimating completed-task gain.
